notes.title: Release date and new trailer
notes.content:
[p]First the big and important stuff.[/p][p]Granser will release in 3 parts.[/p][p]Act 1, 2, and 3.[/p][p]This is sadly unavoidable now.[/p][p][/p][p]The good news? 
[b]Act 1 will release on March 25th of 2026.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To showcase the massive progress since the demo, here is a brand new trailer.[/p][previewyoutube="yL0u8D15yrE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I will talk in detail about current plans, but for now this will have to do.[/p]

notes.title: Developement update
notes.content:
Just a quick update on the state of the game following the new year.

Half of ACT 1 is now complete!
This may not seem like much out of the 3 acts, as it only means 1/6th of the content is finished, but this is a good milestone because this is the point where the game shifts slowly into a more open experience and some of the key reveals in the story occur.

You might have noticed that the game dropped the Early Access label. This is due to me planning to no longer use the system.
This obviously means the release date is moved to "when its done". 
The closest possible release would be in about 2 years from now. :(

I had and is still considering weather or not to do a crowdfunding campaign of some form for the game, not so much to finish it but to give it extra umpf via more music, more voice-acting, etc.

Anyway here is an updated roadmap for the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kfFL3q1.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Developement update
notes.content:
Chapter 3-4 are fully complete.
Chapter 5 is halfway complete now.

Long and short of it is, I was thinking of releasing the game into Early Access at and around chapter 6 when the halfway point of the first arc of the story is reached.

The full game consists of 3 acts, each act containing 13 chapters. 
The demo is the first 2 chapters only.


So the question is should I wait for even more of act 1 to be completed or release at chapter 6.....

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Here is a quick progress tracker for the full game.
As you can see its huge. 
The game will take 2.5-3 years in Early Access to complete, and I wanted to post this for full transparency, and also to show that everything is actually planned out.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RKduE47.png[/img]

This will be updated each time a chapter is complete, currently I'm third of the way through chapter 3.

Early Access should arrive once chapter 4 is complete at the earliest, but I might wait until chapter 6.

All progress can be freely observed in the official discord server.
https://discord.gg/FXUhjdXZkr

notes.title: Demo out now.
notes.content:
A demo featuring the first two chapters is out now.

Saves WILL carry over into Early Access release.
Hope you enjoy it, and wishlist if you do.

notes.title: Voice acting and music
notes.content:
You read that right, a decent portion of the main story will be fully voiced, the first two chapters for the demo are already voiced, and if things remain as they are, the rest of the game will be too.

I have been quiet but the game is being polished up a lot compared to the current videos out. 

Additionally while still in its early stages, the game will feature music by one of the best musicians around, once everything is finalized I will openly announce who it is.
